name: Salvador Choc — a daughter, Antonia, baptised in 1877 at San Pedro Carchá, Guatemala
researcher_question: What children did Salvador Choc of San Pedro Carchá, Alta Verapaz, Guatemala, and his wife Petrona Ba (also recorded as Petrona Choc), who married there on 9 August 1871, have in the 1870s?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 13, hint-samples.csv row 424, flags adds_daughter, confidence 3). The CSV's tree PID 9CB3-PVT now resolves to MGDD-CB5. Resolved 2026-10-31 (issue #3636): true match — Antonia, born 15 August 1877 and baptised 29 October 1877 at San Pedro Carchá, is a daughter of Salvador Choc and Petrona Choc (Petrona Ba), confirmed from the baptism image.
